However, other contracts are not, i.e. adrs, architecture.md, etc. The only good place to ensure their discovery would be repo-local @.agents/AGENTS.md . Give me a refined approach to design this into AGENTS.md. I suppose for ADRs, given there is a shared INDEX.md cache mapping, this should be included instead of brittlely listing all ADRS in there, which could get stale very easily.
